notes: Access: direct fetch worked (Shopify storefront, robots.txt explicitly welcomes crawling: 'Public product, collection, page, blog, policy... HTML is crawlable'). The site is actually a broad Indian furniture+home-decor retailer, not lighting-only as the brief assumed; Furniture, Home Linen, Garden, Hardware, Holiday/Gift/Festive collections and back-order/tax/test collections were excluded per project scope. Category tree built from the header mega-menu (Furniture/Lighting/Decor/Home Linen dropdowns) plus the site's own /pages/sitemap collection index, cross-checked against the full /collections.json enumeration (~80 collections) to catch every real branch. IMPORTANT COUNT-SOURCE FINDING: Shopify's /collections.json 'products_count' field is grossly inflated on this store (e.g. mirrors=382, tableware=1448, artefacts-collectibles=1169, art-wall-decor=1101, lanterns-tea-lights=455, paintings=223, pots-and-planters=271 per that endpoint) -- consistent with prior project finding that storefront count APIs are unreliable. The exact, verified count used instead is /collections/<handle>/products.json paged with de-duped product ids, cross-validated against the collection page's own embedded 'product_count' JSON field (both methods agreed exactly on every collection checked: mirrors 69, tableware 389, art-wall-decor 179, artefacts-collectibles 101, paintings 105, lanterns-tea-lights 44, pots-and-planters 5, lights(parent) 527, pendant-lamps 331, wall-lamps 74, table-lamps 75, floor-lamps 57, chandelier 73). Excluded as non-navigable orphan collections (zero or near-zero products, not linked from header nav or the sitemap page, only discoverable via raw /collections.json sweep): outdoor-lighting (0 products), spot-light (4, orphan), a-festival-of-mirrors (121, a seasonal marketing re-list of items already counted under Mirrors/Decor), birds-of-india (4, marketing subset of Artefacts), importance-of-home-lighting (24, blog-tie-in re-list of Lighting products), dinnerware (3, subset already inside Tableware). Bulbs (7 items) excluded per explicit brief instruction. Rule 0 applied: kept 'TAZIRI ANTIQUE TABLE MIRROR' and similar 'table'/'wall' mirrors despite room words in the name. Mixed roll-ups inspected title-by-title on the FULL product dump (not a sample) and trimmed: (1) Mirrors (69 raw) -> 68 kept, dropped 1 'Almir Brass Photo Frame' (not a mirror). (2) Lanterns & Tea Lights (44 raw) -> 5 kept: 3 semi-precious stone tea-light holders + 1 faux-concrete dove tea-light holder + 1 Sangemarmar tea-light holder (all wax-free decorative holders); dropped 39 scented reed diffusers / fragrance candles / tealights (Home Fragrance, out of scope). (3) Artefacts & Collectibles (101 raw) -> 94 kept, dropped 7: 4 wooden dining/console/study/tea tables + 2 wooden pedestals (furniture) + 1 agate bottle opener (bar tool). (4) Tableware (389 raw) -> 291 kept, dropped 98 via full-title inspection: ~74 cutlery/serveware/bar-tool items (forks, spoons, knives, cake/salad servers, cocktail shakers, bartool sets, straws, cocktail picks, ladles, spatulas, whiskey stones, and dishware bundled with a spoon e.g. 'Soup Bowl with Spoon'), 11 bakeware (loaf pans, roasting pan, baking trays, souffle/quiche dishes), 9 textile (cotton napkins, placemats), 2 stationery (pen cup, pencil case), 1 lighting item mistagged into Tableware ('Vashti ... Table Lamp'), 1 scented tealight set. Kept as genuine tableware/decorative glass: trivets, napkin rings/boxes (wood/metal objects, not textile), coasters, cheese boards without a bundled knife, Kansa (bronze) dinnerware per prior-project precedent, and the full 'Amalfi' decorative art-glass shape line (confirmed 'Amalfi Bulb'/'Amalfi Bulb Large' are bulb-shaped glass vessels in that decorative-shape series -- Moon/Snug/Drop/Ovate/Oyster/Opal/etc -- not light bulbs). Art & Wall Decor (179) and Pichwai Paintings (105) were scanned and found clean (one Diwali-themed Pichwai painting kept in each as genuine wall-art, not treated as Holiday decor since it is a traditional painting subject, not a seasonal ornament). No dedicated Clocks or Glassware collection/branch exists anywhere in the site's navigation or its full /collections.json list; a full-text site search for 'clock' returned only 3 incidental matches and 'glassware' returned noisy false-positive text matches (no curated collection) -- both confirmed absent as distinct catalogue branches, not extracted. Duplicate-company check: no other 'The Purple Turtles' / thepurpleturtles.com entry known elsewhere in this project; first appearance for S.N. 308. The header nav also links two sister/associate brand sites (beruru.com, oorjaa.in) which are separate storefronts, not part of this site's own catalogue, so not traversed here.
